name: Avocado ice cream
summary: Blended avocado dessert sold around Da Lat’s market slope, eaten cold from a cup.
origin: A sweet sold around Da Lat Market. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names the avocado dessert with the market.
howToEat: Eat it standing at the counter while it is still cold.
It is a snack, not a meal. The stall price is Check on arrival.
where: Counters on the Da Lat Market slope and at the night market.
seoTitle: Avocado ice cream — Da Lat kem bo
seoDescription: Kem bơ, blended avocado, at Da Lat Market and the night stalls. The stall price is Check on arrival.
